title: Ivan Pace Jr. #64 2023 Panini Select Black and Green Prizms Die Cuts Vikings RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2023 Panini Select Black and Green Prizms Die Cuts trading card featuring Ivan Pace Jr. of the Minnesota Vikings. The card is an RC, or rookie card, and has the card number 64. It is part of the insert set and has parallel/variety options. The card is perfect for NFL fans and collectors who enjoy sports trading cards.

The card is manufactured by Panini and does not come with an autograph. It is a great addition to any collection and is from the 2023 season. Get your hands on this unique card and add it to your sports trading card collection today!
